name: NOAA Climate Data Online (NCEI)
tagline: Authoritative US climate and weather station archives via NCEI CDO web services
description: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) Climate Data Online (CDO) web services provide programmatic access to historical climate and weather station archives for the United States and global datasets. Developers can query stations, datasets (e.g. GHCND, GSOM, GSOY), data types, locations, and daily/monthly/annual observations. Access is free with a required token; rate limits apply for fair use.

auth.details: Token via token header (not Authorization). Request a free token at the CDO token signup page; include as header token: YOUR_API_KEY on each request.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free with required token; fair-use rate limits apply (see rate_limits). No paid plans published for CDO v2.

rate_limits: 5 requests per second and 10,000 requests per day per token (published CDO web service limits).
use_cases: list available climate datasets (GHCND, GSOM, etc.)
find weather stations near a lat/lon or by location ID
fetch daily precipitation or temperature for a station and date range
query data types available for a dataset or station
look up stations and observations by FIPS/ZIP/city location IDs
